tenders.title: IT Managed Services and Cloud Infrastructure Support
tenders.description: The City wants one vendor to run its help desk, network and cloud infrastructure for five years with two renewals. Tier 1 to 3 help desk for roughly 900 staff, 24 hours a day, with a 15-minute response on critical incidents and 99.9% uptime. Network, server and endpoint management across 12 municipal sites, migration of remaining on-premise workloads to a Canadian cloud region, backup, disaster recovery and quarterly security testing. Data must stay in Canada. The vendor must hold SOC 2 Type II or ISO 27001, provide three references of similar size, and post a performance bond. Scored on technical approach (40), experience and references (25), price (25) and team (10).
